status: frozen after the A1-A3 reports and before synthesis
purpose: Close the finite first-principles search over pure negative-void-gravity mechanisms and state which premise any future candidate must genuinely escape.
fixed_premises: baryons and cosmological boundary data are the only source inputs
no per-object or object-class force parameters
at most four new global physical parameters
one theory must predict both dynamics and lensing
complete_weak_field_mechanism_classes: healthy additive linear field or spectral exchange
direct external void force or regular tide
modified inertia without a metric lensing completion
closure_claim: No mechanism class survives all fixed premises. This is a closure of the declared weak-field theory space, not a proof against every mathematical modification of gravity.
reopen_rule: A new candidate may reopen the search only by identifying which classification assumption it evades, deriving a reciprocal healthy action, and giving a preregistered observable not already represented by radial shape, baryonic mass scaling, environment direction, gravitational slip, or field-energy budget.
allowed_premise_relaxations_for_future_w: permit a self-gravitating vacuum/condensate component and acknowledge that it is observationally a dark sector
permit a MOND/AQUAL-like galaxy limit plus an independently derived cluster component
permit more than one latent response field after same-system data demonstrate that one field is insufficient
defer action selection until raw same-system dynamics and lensing identify the required response dimension
